PLAN "Prenatal Strength - 12 Weeks"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength and functional capacity during pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Weeks 1-4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Body A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          arm_circles 10
          scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60s
          shoulder_stretch 60s
          lat_stretch 60s
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          leg_swings 10
          hip_circles 10
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60s
          hip_flexor_stretch 60s
          hamstring_stretch 60s
      DAY Friday training 50m "Upper Body B":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          arm_circles 10
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60s
          shoulder_stretch 60s
          tricep_stretch 60s
